To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed an electrolyte system for lithium ion batteries that combines the safety of a non-leaking gel polymer electrolyte, the conductivity of a liquid electrolyte, and the thermal stability of a polymer.

a gel polymer electrolytes based on a polymer host consisting of oligo (ethylene) glycol methacrylate and cyclic carbonate methacylate, is able to provide high conductivity and stable cycling behavior in lithium ion batteries.
the gel electrolyte based on OEGMA and CCMA is a suitable matrix to immobilize liquid electrolyte and to realize high performance lithium ion batteries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel polymer electrolyte based on OEGMA and CCMA.
the development of a new gel polymer electrolyte system based on a copolymer matrix with high thermal stability, low glass transition temperature and high conductivity.
the synthesis of a new polymer matrix, which enables the preparation of a gel polymer electrolytes with high thermal, mechanical, and electrochemical stability.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the gel polymer electrolyte developed in this work is a promising electrolyte for high energy and power density lithium ion batteries.
the gel polymer electrolyte developed here can be regarded as a suitable candidate for lithium ion batteries.
the gel electrolytes based on the novel polymer system OEGMA:CCMA are a promising candidate for the application in lithium ion batteries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the gel polymer electrolyte based on OEGMA and CCMA is an interesting alternative to the liquid electrolyte and can be used for high energy density Li ion batteries.

a gel polymer electrolytes can be prepared by using a polymer matrix with cyclic carbonate moieties and that this polymer system can be used as gel polymer electrolyte for high performance lithium ion batteries.
a gel polymer electrolytes based on OEGMA/CCMA copolymer with a high thermal and electrochemical stability is developed.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the gel polymer electrolyte based on OEGMA and CCMA is an excellent candidate as solid electrolyte for lithium batteries.
the gel polymer electrolyte can be used for the fabrication of lithium ion batteries, with a high energy density of 180 Wh kg 1, a good cycling behavior, and high safety.
the combination of OEGMA and CCMA is an effective approach to develop gel polymer electrolytes with high conductivity and good electrochemical performance.
